# Call Della

> Description: An after-hours intake specialist for personal injury law firms.

Della answers your firm's overnight calls, qualifies every caller, and delivers a triage-ready dossier by dawn. Built for personal injury intake from the first call. 

## Key Information
- **What it is**: An AI staffing service, not a software product. Firms hire Della to cover the hours their intake team isn't there.
- **The Problem**: Personal injury firms spend thousands on lead generation, but 30-50% of inbound calls reach voicemail outside business hours. This leak costs an average of $250K+ in lost revenue annually.
- **The Solution**: Della answers within two rings, identifies herself, and asks the right questions (incident type, date, jurisdiction, injury severity, fault, insurance, prior counsel, statute of limitations).
- **The Delivery**: Every overnight call is summarized in a complete dossier available by 7 a.m., including the caller's own words, an AI-generated summary, urgency classification, and recommended action. 
- **Data Security**: Call Della is built for firms that take privilege seriously. Every recording, transcript, and dossier belongs to the firm. Data is never used to train models. SOC 2 Type II audit is underway, and BAA is available.

## Pricing
- **Standard**: $297/month (Up to 400 minutes, 1 dedicated AI intake specialist)
- **Practice**: $547/month (Up to 1000 minutes, SMS notifications, custom protocol, 90-day archive)
- **Group**: Contact Sales (Custom volume, multiple agents, CRM webhook integration)
